idea-plugin.name: OpenCode Commit Message
idea-plugin.description:
Generate well-formed Conventional Commits messages with your local OpenCode CLI, right inside the IDE commit dialog.
  • Tick files in the Commit tool window and click the star button — only the ticked files are sent to the model;
  • With nothing ticked, the staged diff (git diff --cached) is used instead;
  • If the staging area is empty, the plugin can optionally fall back to unstaged changes, and untracked new files are provided as content snapshots;
  • Runs entirely through your local OpenCode process — your code and diffs never leave the machine;
  • Fetch the available model list straight from OpenCode in the settings page and pick one from a searchable popup.
Requirements: a local OpenCode CLI installation (v1.x) with a model configured.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0: initial release — generate Conventional Commits messages from ticked files or the staged diff, with a searchable model picker in the settings.

action.description: Generate a Conventional Commits message by OpenCode, using the ticked files or the staged diff when nothing is ticked.
